translations.web: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
translations.bsb: so a man lies down and does not rise. Until the heavens are no more, he will not be awakened or roused from sleep.
translations.kjv: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
translations.asv: So man lieth down and riseth not: Till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, Nor be roused out of their sleep.
